description: This file contains unit tests for the 'litellm.types.utils' module, testing various classes and functions related to utility data types used in the project.

classes.name: HiddenParams
classes.description: A data class representing hidden parameters with model serialization capabilities.

classes.name: ChatCompletionDeltaToolCall
classes.description: A data class representing a chat completion delta with a function call.

classes.name: Function
classes.description: A data class representing a function call with arguments and name.

classes.name: Choices
classes.description: A class representing choices, instantiated without parameters in test.

classes.name: Usage
classes.description: A data class capturing token usage details, including nested token detail structures.

classes.name: CompletionTokensDetailsWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for completion token details.

classes.name: PromptTokensDetailsWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for prompt token details.

methods.name: test_hidden_params_response_ms()
methods.description: Tests that HiddenParams sets and dumps the _response_ms attribute correctly.

methods.name: test_chat_completion_delta_tool_call()
methods.description: Tests creation of ChatCompletionDeltaToolCall with a nested Function and verifies 'function' is present.

methods.name: test_usage_dump()
methods.description: Tests the dump of Usage object including nested token details.

methods.name: test_usage_completion_tokens_details_text_tokens()
methods.description: Tests handling of detailed token counts in Usage, including model dump and re-instantiation.
